column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Like the dead of antiquity” is rendered “like those who have long been dead.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “Therefore.”
NASB adds “longs” to the verbless line “my throat [is] like an exhausted land to you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will be equal with” is rendered “I will become like.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Desire” (literally “soul”) is rendered “my soul.”
“To you I have covered [myself]” is rendered “I take refuge in You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A land of level ground” is rendered “level ground,” and NASB capitalizes “Your good Spirit.”
Close to the Hebrew; The future “you will preserve me alive … you will bring out” is rendered as requests, “revive me … bring.”
Close to the Hebrew; The future “you will destroy” is rendered as requests, “cut off … destroy.”
